verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a headless mode, CLI, or CI integration for running TeamViewer unattended in automation pipelines. The bare 'Web API' listing, MSI mass deployment, and remote script execution or automated remediation features are adjacent: an API building block, a deployment method, and in-product endpoint automation, not headless or CI operation of the product itself. The OpenAPI and llms.txt probes also returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
